interpretation: Post-hoc exploratory window sensitivity; pointwise intervals, no new confirmatory gates or simultaneous superiority decisions
event_rule: delta_h = saved_observed AND saved_time <= h; T_h = min(saved_time,h); Y_h=T_h/h; an event exactly at h is observed even when Y_h=1
source_censoring: common pure administrative censoring at H=12*n; an unobserved event has saved_time=H; no extension beyond H
weights: 7 traces equally per parent; registered binary bracket arms equally within source panel; 20 parents per model, 3 model means equally; phases and sizes separate
rng: SHA256(seed|phase|size|replicate|model), Python random.Random; shared parent indices across windows, scopes, comparisons and both endpoints
intervals: pointwise unadjusted 95 percent; inverse ECDF nearest ranks 500 and 19500 of 20000; integer numerator sorting and exact rational denominators
reported_intervals: combined-scope 160 window contrasts and 80 paired half-minus-full changes; 320 additional scope contrasts and 160 scope changes descriptive only
change_rule: paired difference of normalized effects at half and full; account for both clipping and changed normalization; risk at half minus full
data_validation: raw bytes must match S3 verified parent snapshot and frozen delivery inventory; saved events must match result witness and original full-window trace contrasts; no hidden routing replay
checkpoint: atomic parent envelopes, compressed integer sums per 500 bootstrap replicates, PAUSE at safe boundaries; code/config/runtime/source binding
limitations: Both phases previously inspected; this is not new preregistered confirmation.
Repeated windows are measurements of the same parent/trace, not additional independent graphs.
Pointwise intervals are not simultaneous confidence bands and are not used to select a favourable window.
Zero empirical intervals are not proof of population equivalence.
Window changes alter both censoring and time normalization; comparing two normalized time effects is not a pure scaling effect.
No common absolute 360-request window, prefix-cost analysis, new initialization arm, future-time extrapolation or uncensored lifetime quantile is added in this version.
